d: The Corporate Sales Manager is responsible for developing and implementing corporate sales strategies to maximize hotel revenue, profitability, and market share. The role focuses on acquiring new corporate accounts, strengthening existing business relationships, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving corporate room night production, group bookings, and long-term business opportunities.

The position also manages corporate account performance, monitors market trends and competitor activities, and collaborates with Revenue Management to optimize pricing and sales opportunities. The Corporate Sales Manager works closely with the Director of Sales & Marketing and operational departments to achieve commercial objectives, maintain client satisfaction, and support sustainable business growth.
Develop and implement corporate sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets.
Identify and secure new corporate accounts through sales calls, client visits, networking, and industry events.
Drive corporate transient, group, and long-term accommodation business opportunities.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and corporate demand to identify growth opportunities.
Manage and develop corporate accounts to maximize retention, revenue contribution, and business growth.
Build strong relationships with corporate decision-makers, travel managers, and business partners.
Conduct client presentations, hotel site inspections, sales missions, and networking activities.
Address escalated client concerns and ensure timely resolution of service-related issues.
Negotiate corporate rates, annual agreements, and commercial contracts in alignment with hotel revenue strategies.
Collaborate with Revenue Management to evaluate pricing, corporate production, and market demand.
Identify opportunities to improve account profitability and corporate market positioning.
Monitor corporate contract performance and renewal opportunities.
Monitor corporate sales activities, revenue performance, and achievement of established targets.
Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and corporate account performance reviews.
Maintain accurate client records, contracts, and sales activities in the CRM system.
Provide market insights and commercial recommendations to the Director of Sales & Marketing.
Coordinate with Front Office, Reservations, Catering, and Guest Services to ensure effective delivery of corporate requirements.
Support VIP arrangements and personalized services for key corporate clients.
Represent the hotel at trade shows, corporate travel events, and relevant networking functions.
We are looking for a Cost Accountant to join our accounting department. You’ll be responsible for performing cost analyses and preparing budget reports.
The ideal candidate should possess excellent analytical skills along with the ability to combine different data and calculate profit margins and manage cost information to maximize profitability.
Handle product costing, cost allocation and profitability analysis.
Monitor raw material consumption, production costs and inventory valuation.
Analyse production variances, wastage, yield and capacity utilisation.
Prepare monthly costing reports, MIS and product-wise profitability statements.
Work closely with production and procurement teams to understand cost drivers and identify areas for cost improvement.
Assist in preparing and updating the company's business and financial models, including production volumes, capacity utilisation, raw material costs, operating expenses and profitability projections.
Support budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
Assist with monthly closing, inventory reconciliation and financial reporting.
Review existing costing processes and suggest improvements.
q: Minimum 5 years of experience in manufacturing costing, preferably in the steel industry.
Hands-on experience in SAP is mandatory, preferably SAP S/4HANA with knowledge of the CO module.
Good understanding of financial accounting and general accounting principles.
